description: This file contains Swagger API resource definitions for interest rate charts in the Fineract project, including response and request schemas, and nested classes for chart slabs, currency, and template responses.

classes.name: InterestRateChartsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains Swagger schema definitions for interest rate chart API responses and requests.

classes.name: GetInterestRateChartsTemplateResponse
classes.description: Schema for the template response of interest rate charts.

classes.name: GetInterestRateChartsTemplatePeriodTypes
classes.description: Schema for interest rate chart period types within the template response.

classes.name: GetInterestRateChartsResponse
classes.description: Schema for the interest rate charts response.

classes.name: GetInterestRateChartsChartSlabs
classes.description: Schema for individual chart slabs within the interest rate chart response.

classes.name: GetInterestRateChartsCurrency
classes.description: Schema for currency details within the interest rate chart response.

classes.name: PostInterestRateChartsRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new interest rate chart.

classes.name: PostInterestRateChartsResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after creating an interest rate chart.

classes.name: PutInterestRateChartsChartIdRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating an interest rate chart.

classes.name: PutInterestRateChartsChartIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after updating an interest rate chart.

classes.name: DeleteInterestRateChartsChartIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after deleting an interest rate chart.
